subject: SolidGeometry

projection.note: Each separate object is uniformly scaled and translated on the common page; no stretching.

visibility.description: For each occupied voxel, +x, -y and +z outward faces without an adjacent voxel; frozen face list, painted by frozen depth; unshown back/bottom faces omitted.

constraints: Unit cubes share entire faces; each of three colors is a single face-connected four-cube block.
